items.title: 跳槽還帶走逾百份檔案？OpenAI控前員工向蘋果高層簡報機密
items.title_en: Did a Job Switcher Take Over a Hundred Files? OpenAI Accuses Former Employee of Presenting Confidential Material to Apple Executives
paras: OpenAI與蘋果(AAPL-US)的營業秘密訴訟再添爭議。OpenAI在最新法院文件中指控，一名轉職蘋果的前員工，曾將逾100份涉及未發表產品的檔案傳送至個人帳戶，之後更向蘋果高層簡報該產品。蘋果則表示，未發現證據支持這些指控。
據《路透》報導，OpenAI本周二(13日)向加州聖荷西聯邦法院提交文件，指稱這場面向蘋果高層的簡報發生於數月前。OpenAI並提及蘋果本周推出的HomeView產品，指出蘋果如今也在開發自家AI產品。
OpenAI在文件中表示，非常擔心公司的營業秘密與機密資訊正在蘋果內部流傳，使蘋果工程師能以OpenAI尚未公開的創新成果為基礎，規劃未來產品。
對此，蘋果表示，公司設有相關政策與程序，確保新進員工不會使用前雇主的機密資訊，且未發現證據支持OpenAI的指控。
這份文件是雙方持續進行的營業秘密爭議之一。訴訟最初由蘋果於今年稍早提出，當時蘋果指控，部分員工離職後將公司機密資訊帶往OpenAI的硬體部門；OpenAI已否認相關指控。
如今OpenAI也對蘋果提出類似指控，讓兩家公司圍繞人才流動與未公開硬體資訊的爭議進一步升高。雙方均否認對方指控，目前所述內容仍屬訴訟中的主張。
paras_en: OpenAI and Apple (AAPL-US) have added another controversy to their trade secret lawsuit. In the latest court filing, OpenAI alleges that a former employee who moved to Apple transferred more than 100 files concerning an unreleased product to a personal account, and later presented that product to Apple senior management. Apple says it has found no evidence to support these allegations.

According to Reuters, OpenAI filed documents with the U.S. District Court in San Jose, California on Tuesday the 13th, claiming the presentation to Apple executives took place several months ago. The filing also references Apple’s recently launched HomeView product, noting that Apple is now developing its own AI offerings.

OpenAI’s filing states it is deeply concerned that its trade secrets and confidential information are circulating within Apple, enabling Apple engineers to base future products on OpenAI innovations that have not yet been made public.
Apple responded that it has policies and procedures in place to ensure new hires do not use former employers’ confidential information, and that it has found no evidence supporting OpenAI’s claims.

The document is one of several ongoing trade‑secret disputes between the two companies. The lawsuit was originally filed by Apple earlier this year, accusing some former employees of taking company secrets to OpenAI’s hardware division; OpenAI has denied those allegations.

Now OpenAI has made similar accusations against Apple, raising the stakes in the dispute over talent mobility and undisclosed hardware information. Both sides deny each other’s claims, and the statements described remain allegations within the litigation.

items.title: 長鑫科技引發記憶體股崩！高盛示警：700億美元多頭恐成下一波風險
paras: 全球人工智慧（AI）投資熱潮推升記憶體族群股價大幅走高，如今卻因中國長鑫科技(688825-CN) 傳出技術突破，引發市場重新評估記憶體產業的競爭格局與獲利前景。高盛最新報告指出，先前推動行情的投機性資金已出現撤退跡象，但規模約700億美元的資產管理機構多頭部位仍接近歷史高點，後續是否跟進減碼，將成為左右市場走勢的關鍵。
高盛策略師Robert Quinn在最新報告《那斯達克期貨：記憶體崩跌》（Nasdaq Futures: Memory Meltdown）中，透過期貨市場持倉數據分析本輪賣壓，發現短線投機資金在行情反轉前，已將那斯達克期貨多頭部位推升至近一年高點，隨後面臨停損出場壓力。
相較之下，長期資產管理機構的多頭部位尚未出現明顯鬆動，潛在賣壓仍不可忽視。
這波修正已擴散至全球半導體市場。高盛追蹤的記憶體與AI半導體投資組合，在10月5日至12日期間分別下跌9.3%與6.7%。
此外，南韓股市同步承壓，鎧俠（Kioxia）股價大幅下挫，三星電子(005930KS) 、SK海力士(000660KS) 、美光科技(MU-US) 、威騰電子(WDC-US) 及希捷科技(STX-US) 等主要記憶體相關企業，單日跌幅介於5%至15%。

記憶體交易從暴漲到回檔　市場開始質疑高獲利能否持續

高盛的記憶體投資組合指數過去一年經歷大幅上漲。該指數從一年前約600點起步，今年6月底攀升至約2,675點，近期則回落至約1,900點。
儘管如此，該投資組合目前仍較一年前高出逾兩倍，但相較6月高點已回檔約25%。對於先前累積大量獲利、持倉高度集中的交易而言，這種幅度的修正，可能進一步壓縮投資人的風險承受空間，並增加追加保證金或停損出場的壓力。
引發市場重新評估記憶體產業前景的導火線，是中國記憶體製造商長鑫科技宣稱，在新型4F² DRAM架構上取得關鍵進展，並表示有望在記憶體密度方面領先三星電子與SK海力士。
不過，根據《彭博》報導，相關說法尚未獲得證實。
特斯拉執行長馬斯克隨後也在社群平台發文指出，中國一旦掌握某項產品的製造技術，其規模化生產能力往往可能超越其他地區總和。
他並提醒市場，記憶體產業在三年前仍屬低利潤率的大宗商品市場，進一步加深投資人對記憶體產業高毛利能否長期維持的疑慮。

槓桿資金曾在高點加碼　市場轉弱後開始退場

除了股票價格，高盛也從融資市場觀察投資人行為。
Quinn指出，那斯達克三個月期融資利率相對聯邦基金利率的溢價，在記憶體股開始下跌期間仍持續攀升，顯示槓桿多頭最初並未立即撤退。然而，隨著市場在10月12日進一步走弱，資金動向開始出現轉變。
目前，那斯達克三個月期融資利率相對聯邦基金利率的溢價約為76個基點，約為3月低點的兩倍，但仍低於6月市場高點時約124個基點的水準。
另一項指標也顯示，那斯達克相對標普500指數的融資溢價，在10月初升至年內高點約7個基點後，隨即於本週一的賣壓中反轉向下。

投機資金多頭部位創一年新高　行情反轉後面臨停損

高盛分析中另一項重要依據，是美國商品期貨交易委員會（CFTC）的交易者持倉報告（COT）。
數據顯示，那斯達克期貨市場中「其他交易者」類別的總多頭部位，在10月6日達到約96億美元，較7月初約30億美元增加逾兩倍。該類別通常涵蓋部分投機性資金與自營交易者。
同期，這類交易者的多頭部位占未平倉合約比重，也從6月底約1.4%升至約5.4%，兩項指標均達過去一年高點。
值得注意的是，10月6日正值市場對OpenAI營收預期產生疑慮前一週，也是長鑫科技公布相關進展前五天。換言之，投機資金在市場反轉前，已將多頭部位推升至近一年高位。
隨著行情轉弱，這批資金可能開始停損並降低曝險。Quinn在報告中指出，近期建立的多頭部位可能已經減少，意味短線資金很可能未能在高點順利出場。

700億美元多頭仍接近歷史高點　長線資金成下一波賣壓關鍵

相較於投機資金已出現退場跡象，高盛更關注資產管理機構的持倉變化。
截至10月6日，資產管理機構持有的那斯達克期貨總多頭部位約達700億美元，接近6月創下的約710億美元歷史紀錄，較3月底約440億美元大幅增加。
Quinn指出，這些機構的多頭持倉與記憶體及AI半導體股的價格走勢，並未呈現明顯相關性。換言之，即使相關股票近期大幅回檔，機構持倉仍未出現相應幅度的調整。
這些資金持續看好半導體產業，並非毫無依據。高盛先前估算，僅美光一家企業，就可能貢獻標普500指數第三季獲利成長的19%。此外，記憶體產業目前的獲利能力相當突出，南亞科最新一季毛利率更達85.7%。
不過，市場對記憶體股的評價也正出現變化。根據《彭博》報導，Pictet Asset Management的Jon Withaar指出，記憶體股已轉變為具有價值股特徵的標的，以目前獲利衡量，估值相對便宜；但散戶與短線投機型避險基金通常不會積極追逐價值股。
分析指出，真正的考驗在於，持有約700億美元多頭部位的資產管理機構，是否會將目前約25%的回檔視為加碼機會，或開始重新檢視記憶體供需與獲利前景。
高盛韓國團隊先前提出的核心問題仍待解答：記憶體供給緊張的局面，能否延續至2028年以前？高盛預期，屆時長鑫科技的DRAM供應量將達SK海力士的一半。

艾司摩爾、台積電財報成觀察指標　記憶體股後市取決於機構態度

對於接下來的市場走勢，Quinn對資產管理機構是否減碼仍持審慎態度，認為其後續影響尚有爭議。
高盛自營交易團隊則預期，半導體族群下跌後可能出現買盤，而艾司摩爾(ASML-US) 與台積電(2330-TW) 的財報，將成為近期觀察市場反應的重要指標。
目前市場呈現出明顯的資金分化：槓桿資金曾在行情高點加碼，投機性資金的多頭部位則在市場反轉前升至一年高點；另一方面，規模約700億美元的資產管理機構多頭部位，仍接近歷史紀錄。
在記憶體股已從高點回檔約25%、南韓市場承受沉重賣壓之際，長鑫科技的技術進展也讓市場開始重新檢視記憶體產業的競爭門檻與利潤空間。
後續行情的關鍵，除了中國記憶體廠商能否持續取得技術突破，也在於大型資產管理機構如何解讀這波修正。如果長線資金選擇逢低布局，市場可能獲得支撐；但若機構開始降低持倉，原本尚未反映在價格中的潛在賣壓，則可能進一步浮現。

items.title: 1兆美元恐蒸發！晶片股賣壓加劇 費半近六日跌一成
items.title_en: $1 Trillion at Risk of Vanishing! Chip Stock Selling Pressure Intensifies, Philly Semiconductor Index Down About 10% Over Six Days
paras: 半導體股賣壓加劇，費城半導體指數近六個交易日累計下跌約10%，成分股市值恐合計蒸發逾1兆美元。利率走高、估值偏高，以及人工智慧(AI)基礎建設的龐大支出，引發投資人對這波AI投資熱潮的疑慮。
費城半導體指數(SOX)周三(14日)盤中下跌3.1%，若跌勢延續至收盤，將連續第六個交易日走低，創2025年5月以來最長連跌紀錄。
過去六個交易日，逾半數成分股跌幅至少達10%。其中，安謀(ARM-US)累計下挫近20%，應用材料(AMAT-US)下跌約15%，英特爾(INTC-US)跌11%；格芯(GFS-US)則是這段期間唯一上漲的成分股，表現優於同業。
瑞銀(UBS-US)投資總監辦公室的Ulrike Hoffmann-Burchardi在周三研究報告中指出，全球晶片股近日承受的壓力持續增加。不過，她認為，雖然AI領域競爭加劇、融資需求攀升與利率走高，可能不時加大市場波動，這波下跌更像是投資人重新調整預期，而非AI投資的基本面出現根本性轉變。
過去一周，以半導體股為主的全球AI概念股遭到拋售。博通(AVGO-US)執行長陳福陽本周稍早將部分追逐AI熱潮的投資人比作賭徒，並警告產業可能面臨資金限制，進一步加深市場疑慮。
最新壓力則來自美國9月通膨數據高於預期，強化市場對聯準會(Fed)進一步升息的預期，即使決策官員可能在本月稍晚的會議上暫時按兵不動，後續緊縮風險仍壓抑市場情緒。
接下來的觀察焦點，是Anthropic預定周三稍晚在舊金山向特定投資人進行簡報。華爾街將尋找該公司按目前營收速度推算的全年營收規模等線索，藉此判斷市場對AI支出的需求強度。
Hoffmann-Burchardi建議，投資人應關注哪些領域的AI支出，正轉化為可持續的獲利成長，以及更廣泛的企業與消費者採用。
paras_en: Semiconductor stocks are under increasing selling pressure, with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index falling roughly 10% over the past six trading days, potentially wiping out more than $1 trillion in market value across its components. Higher interest rates, lofty valuations and massive AI infrastructure spending have sparked investor doubts about the current AI investment frenzy.

The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index (SOX) slipped 3.1% during Wednesday’s (the 14th) session. If the decline holds through the close, it will mark a sixth consecutive down day, the longest losing streak since May 2025.

In the last six trading sessions, more than half of the components fell at least 10%. Notably, Arm Ltd. (ARM-US) has dropped nearly 20% cumulatively, Applied Materials (AMAT-US) about 15%, and Intel (INTC-US) 11%; GlobalFoundries (GFS-US) was the only stock to rise during this period, outperforming its peers.

Ulrike Hoffmann‑Burchardi of UBS’s Investment Director Office wrote in a Wednesday research note that global chip stocks are feeling mounting pressure. She believes that while heightened AI competition, rising financing needs and higher rates may increase volatility, the sell‑off reflects investors readjusting expectations rather than a fundamental shift in AI fundamentals.

Over the past week, AI‑related stocks led by semiconductor companies have been sold off. Broadcom CEO Hock Tan earlier this week likened some AI‑chasing investors to gamblers and warned that the industry could face funding constraints, deepening market concerns.

The latest strain comes from U.S. September inflation data that came in above expectations, bolstering bets that the Federal Reserve will keep raising rates. Even if policymakers pause at their upcoming meeting later this month, the lingering tightening risk continues to dampen sentiment.

All eyes now turn to Anthropic, which is slated to brief select investors in San Francisco later Wednesday. Wall Street will look for clues about the company’s full‑year revenue potential based on its current sales trajectory to gauge the strength of AI‑spending demand.
Hoffmann‑Burchardi advises investors to focus on which AI‑spending areas are translating into sustainable profit growth and broader enterprise and consumer adoption.

items.title: 美債殖利率若衝上6%怎麼辦？戴蒙示警風險 科技七巨頭意外成資金避風港
items.title_en: What If U.S. Treasury Yields Surge Past 6%? Dimon Warns of Risks, Tech Giants Unexpectedly Become Safe Havens
paras: 美國10年期公債殖利率近期升破5%，市場對殖利率進一步攀升至6%的警戒升高。摩根大通(JPMorgan Chase)執行長戴蒙(Jamie Dimon)周二(13日)表示，他並非預測殖利率一定會升至6%，但建議投資人為此做好準備。
若10年期美債殖利率從9月觸及的5%水準再升高1個百分點，帶來的衝擊恐比今年2月底伊朗戰爭爆發後、殖利率在半年內上升1個百分點更加嚴重。
殖利率攀升已推高家庭、農民、企業及美國政府的借貸成本，也打壓消費者信心。在房貸利率上升的影響下，美國房市長期低迷，而節節上升的殖利率，也開始壓抑今年以來小型股及其他對利率敏感類股的漲勢。

AI投資熱潮推升殖利率？市場對6%警戒升高

川普政府內部有一種看法認為，殖利率走高反映美國經濟強勁成長，而這股成長動能來自史無前例的AI基礎建設投資。若是如此，邁入第四年的美股多頭行情或許還有進一步上漲空間，但另一種可能是，資金成本將持續攀升，進一步壓縮經濟活動。
其他分析人士則認為，美債殖利率上升與多項因素有關，包括AI投資熱潮帶來龐大的資金需求、通膨升溫疑慮、美國一年接近2兆美元的預算赤字、高達40兆美元的國債，以及美國財政部為填補資金缺口而大量發行公債。
今年約2500億美元的AI相關債券湧入投資級公司債市場，對此Columbia Threadneedle Investments資深投資組合經理Tom Murphy說：「到目前為止，市場對這些公司仍然持開放態度。」
根據Columbia Threadneedle預估，超大規模雲端業者(hyperscalers)與SpaceX(SPCX-US)今年的資本支出預料總計將近9000億美元，且到2030年，每年支出將超過1兆美元。

殖利率攀升下的意外現象：科技七巨頭成資金避風港

目前的殖利率水準，對存款者與債券投資人而言，反而可能帶來收益機會。龐大的借貸需求也意味著，持有債券的投資人可取得相對較高的收益率。
不過，市場對其他經濟領域能否承受高利率的疑慮，再次帶動AI概念股的「避險交易」。這種現象看似矛盾，卻反映投資人擔心高利率衝擊整體經濟時，反而轉向被視為成長動能較強的大型科技股。
追蹤科技七巨頭的Roundhill Magnificent Seven ETF(MAGS-US)在周二為止的一個月內上漲6.4%，面對利率上升風險發揮了一部分避險作用。FactSet數據顯示，這段期間10年期美債殖利率上升約1.3個百分點，標普500指數則上漲2%。
另一個值得注意的變化是，當AI交易中漲幅較大的部分領域表現疲弱時，例如半導體股占比較高的南韓股市，較長天期的美債反而開始吸引買盤，帶動殖利率回落。
由於債券價格上漲時，殖利率會下跌，這代表部分資金可能在AI投資疑慮升高時，轉向較具防禦性的公債。若這種因AI疑慮而出現的避險買盤持續，可能抑制美債殖利率進一步走高。

高利率壓力恐擴散 AI熱潮掩蓋其他經濟警訊

DWS美洲區固定收益主管George Catrambone表示，10年期美債殖利率周二約為5.23%，距離6%仍有「非常大的差距」。但他也指出，高殖利率已讓一部分與AI無直接關係的經濟領域承受壓力。
Catrambone表示，若殖利率持續走高，這種壓力將進一步擴散，企業與家庭取得資金的難度可能提高，借貸成本也會更貴。考量到伊朗戰爭推高汽油與能源價格，加上過去五年通膨一直處於高檔，家庭將面臨更沉重的財務壓力。
Catrambone認為，「市場對AI有太多自滿情緒」，並補充說自己並非看空AI，但這股熱潮掩蓋了經濟中許多至少已亮起警示燈的領域。
paras_en: U.S. 10-year Treasury yields have recently broken above 5%, raising market vigilance about a possible climb to 6%. JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon said on Tuesday the 13th that while he does not predict yields will definitely reach 6%, investors should be prepared for that scenario.

If the 10-year Treasury yield, which hit 5% in September, rises another percentage point, the impact could be even more severe than the one seen after the Iran war erupted at the end of February, when yields rose a full point within six months.

Higher yields have pushed up borrowing costs for households, farmers, businesses and the U.S. government, and have dampened consumer confidence. Rising mortgage rates have kept the housing market weak for a long time, and the steadily climbing yields are also curbing the rally of small‑cap stocks and other rate‑sensitive equities this year.

AI investment frenzy driving yields higher? Markets grow more wary of a 6% level. Some within the Trump administration view rising yields as a sign of a robust U.S. economy powered by unprecedented AI infrastructure spending. If that’s the case, the fourth year of the bull market could still have upside, but another possibility is that financing costs keep climbing, further squeezing economic activity.

Other analysts say the rise in Treasury yields is linked to multiple factors, including massive funding needs from the AI boom, lingering inflation concerns, a near‑$2 trillion annual U.S. budget deficit, $40 trillion of national debt, and the Treasury’s large‑scale issuance of bonds to fill the funding gap.

About $250 billion of AI‑related bonds have flowed into the investment‑grade corporate bond market this year, and Columbia Threadneedle senior portfolio manager Tom Murphy notes, “So far the market remains open to these companies.”

Columbia Threadneedle estimates that hyperscale cloud providers and SpaceX (SPCX‑US) will together spend close to $900 billion on capital expenditures this year, and annual spending is projected to exceed $1 trillion by 2030.

An unexpected side effect of rising yields: the seven big tech firms have become a safe haven for capital. At current yield levels, depositors and bond investors may actually find yield opportunities, and the huge borrowing demand means bondholders can earn relatively high returns.

However, doubts about whether other sectors can withstand high rates have sparked “hedge” trades in AI‑related stocks. This seemingly contradictory behavior reflects investors shifting to large‑cap tech stocks, seen as having stronger growth momentum, when they fear high rates could hurt the broader economy.

The Roundhill Magnificent Seven ETF (MAGS‑US), which tracks the seven tech giants, rose 6.4% over the month ending Tuesday, providing some hedge against rising rates. FactSet data show that during that period the 10‑year Treasury yield rose about 1.3 percentage points while the S&P 500 gained 2%.

Another notable shift is that when AI‑driven sectors that have surged begin to lag—such as South Korea’s equity market, which has a high weighting of semiconductor stocks—long‑dated U.S. Treasuries start attracting buying, pulling yields lower.

Because bond prices rise when yields fall, some capital may move from AI‑related investments to more defensive Treasuries when AI concerns intensify. If this AI‑driven defensive buying persists, it could curb further upside in Treasury yields.

DWS Americas fixed‑income head George Catrambone said the 10‑year yield was about 5.23% on Tuesday, still “a very large gap” from 6%. He added that high yields are already putting pressure on economic areas not directly tied to AI.

Catrambone warned that if yields keep climbing, the pressure will spread, making financing harder and more expensive for companies and households. With the Iran war pushing up gasoline and energy prices and inflation having stayed high for five years, families will face heavier financial strain.
Catrambone believes “the market is overly complacent about AI.” He clarified he is not bearish on AI itself, but the hype is masking many economic sectors that have already lit warning lights.

items.title: 美股平靜時光所剩不多 月底起四大事件接力、預期波動增50%
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Have Little Calm Left; Four Major Events Starting End of Month Expected to Boost Volatility by 50%
paras: 歷經波折不斷的夏季後，美股似乎進入一段平靜期。投資人或許該把握這段寧靜時光，因為選擇權市場正暗示本月下旬起，恐將迎來一波波動潮。
選擇權分析平台ORATS創辦人馬特·安伯森（Matt Amberson）向 MarketWatch 表示，當前情勢堪稱「暴風雨前的寧靜」。
根據道瓊市場數據（Dow Jones Market Data）分析選擇權定價結果，隨著美國聯準會（Fed）即將公布最新利率決策，自 10 月 28 日起標普 500 指數的預期單日波動幅度，平均將激增約 50%。
選擇權市場的定價顯示，隨著聯準會利率決策、重磅企業財報、美國期中選舉以及 10 月非農就業報告這「四大事件」自月底起接連登場，市場恐將告別平靜，並一舉觸發美股新一波劇烈波動。
其中最受矚目的重頭戲莫過於 11 月 3 日的期中選舉，而這波關鍵密集期將在 11 月 6 日公布的 10 月非農就業報告中畫下句點。
安伯森在電子郵件中表示，目前重大總體經濟催化因素不多，周三(14日)公布的消費者物價指數（CPI）報告是少數焦點。
不過，選擇權交易員正為本月底起更劇烈的行情預作準備，屆時投資人將接連面對聯準會決策、多家重要企業財報、期中選舉及 10 月就業報告。
類股輪動 壓低大盤波動
有華爾街「恐慌指數」之稱的芝加哥選擇權交易所波動率指數（VIX），數月來持續走低。然而，標普 500 成分股中仍有個股大幅震盪，不同產業股票的走勢也日益分歧。
這種檯面下的高度分化，有助於抑制指數層級的波動。當受惠人工智慧（AI）熱潮的股票表現疲弱時，所謂的「非 AI」股票便挺身支撐大盤，反之亦然。
BTIG 首席技術策略師克林斯基（Jonathan Krinsky）指出，截至週一為止，標普 500 指數已連續 52 個交易日未曾出現單日 1% 以上的跌幅。若再維持一天，這將創下 2020 年 1 月以來最長無顯著拉回紀錄。他認為，近期成交量萎縮無疑是造成大盤走勢沉悶的主因之一。
克林斯基在報告中分析，市場目前正處於重磅總經數據、關鍵催化劑與財報季之間的真空期，缺乏足以推動大盤的重大新消息，投資人普遍傾向觀望，靜待本週稍後大型銀行股開開首槍後再做決策。
他補充道，指數層級缺乏波動的時間長度，確實超出了他與許多市場人士的預期。
隨著美國大型銀行自周二起陸續公布業績，第三季財報季預料將正式進入高峰。
標普500距上次修正已久 超過歷史平均
標普 500 指數也已有一段時間未出現修正，通常定義為自近期高點下跌至少 10%。根據 Bespoke Investment Group 的分析，截至周一收盤，距離最近一次修正結束，已過了 552 個交易日。
最近一次修正始於美國總統川普第二任期初期，並在 2025 年 4 月上旬達到最劇烈階段。當時，川普宣布「解放日」關稅措施後，標普 500 指數一度跌至熊市邊緣。
Bespoke 表示，目前連續 552 個交易日未出現修正，為 1950 年以來第 12 長紀錄，也超過自 1928 年以來兩次修正平均間隔 246 個交易日的2倍。
paras_en: After a tumultuous summer, U.S. equities appear to have entered a period of calm. Investors may want to seize this quiet time, as the options market hints that a wave of volatility could arrive in late October.
Matt Amberson, founder of options‑analysis platform ORATS, told MarketWatch that the current situation is akin to "the calm before the storm."

Based on options‑pricing data from Dow Jones Market Data, the expected one‑day swing of the S&P 500 is projected to jump about 50% on average starting October 28, as the Federal Reserve prepares to announce its latest rate decision.

Options pricing shows that with the Fed’s rate decision, heavyweight corporate earnings, the U.S. midterm elections and the October non‑farm payroll report – the “four major events” – rolling out from the end of the month, the market is likely to abandon its tranquility and trigger a fresh bout of sharp equity volatility.
The most watched headline is the November 3 midterm election, and this intense rally of catalysts will conclude with the October payroll report released on November 6.
Amberson wrote in an email that there are few major macro‑economic catalysts right now; the Consumer Price Index (CPI) report due on Wednesday the 14th is one of the few focal points.

Nevertheless, options traders are positioning for a more turbulent market from the end of the month onward, when investors will face the Fed decision, multiple key corporate earnings, the midterms and the October jobs report in quick succession.
Sector rotation dampens overall market volatility

The Chicago Board Options Exchange’s VIX, often called Wall Street’s “fear gauge,” has been trending lower for months. Yet individual S&P 500 constituents are still seeing sharp moves, and stocks across different industries are diverging increasingly.
This underlying fragmentation helps curb index‑level swings. When AI‑related stocks lag, the so‑called “non‑AI” stocks step in to support the broader market, and vice versa.

Jonathan Krinsky, chief technical strategist at BTIG, noted that as of Monday the S&P 500 has gone 52 consecutive trading days without a single‑day decline of 1% or more. If it holds for another day, it would set the longest stretch without a notable pullback since January 2020. He believes the recent shrinkage in trading volume is a key factor behind the market’s sluggishness.

Krinsky’s report says the market is currently in a vacuum between heavyweight macro data, key catalysts and earnings season, lacking any major new news to move the index. Investors are broadly waiting on the sidelines, planning to act after large‑bank stocks make the first move later this week.
He added that the length of time the index has gone without volatility exceeds both his and many market participants’ expectations.
With U.S. large banks beginning to release earnings from Tuesday onward, the third‑quarter earnings season is expected to hit its peak soon.
S&P 500 Has Not Corrected in a Long Time, Exceeding Historical Average

The S&P 500 has also gone a considerable stretch without a correction, typically defined as a drop of at least 10% from a recent high. Bespoke Investment Group’s analysis shows that as of Monday’s close, it has been 552 trading days since the last correction ended.

The most recent correction began early in President Trump’s second term and peaked in early April 2025. At that time, after Trump announced a “Liberation Day” tariff measure, the S&P 500 briefly fell to the edge of a bear market.

Bespoke says the current 552‑day streak without a correction is the 12th longest on record since 1950, more than twice the historical average interval of 246 trading days between corrections dating back to 1928.

items.title: 別想只靠成長還債！IMF給兩大經濟體開藥方：美國少花中國多花
items.title_en: Don’t Rely on Growth Alone to Reduce Debt! IMF Prescribes Remedies for Two Major Economies: US Should Spend Less, China Should Spend More
paras: 全球債券殖利率攀升、政府債務壓力加重，國際貨幣基金(IMF)總裁喬治艾娃(Kristalina Georgieva)周三(14日)敦促主要經濟體調整政策，直言美國不能只靠經濟成長化解債務問題，仍須採取稅收或支出措施；中國則應降低對出口的依賴，轉向擴大內需消費。
據《路透》報導，喬治艾娃在曼谷舉行的IMF與世界銀行年會上指出，美國與歐洲等先進經濟體是債務過高問題最嚴重的國家，其基準公債殖利率走高，也將壓力傳導至低所得國家，後者早已被金融市場迫使縮減借款。
她將主要經濟體的政策方向概括為：「中國需要多消費，美國必須多儲蓄，歐洲則必須多投資。」

美國不能只靠成長減債 IMF提高財政整頓急迫性

被問及美國是否需要收緊財政政策時，喬治艾娃表示，美國財政部長貝森特認知到，赤字與債務水準過高，需要提高可持續性，但美國政府目前相當仰賴強勁經濟成長來減輕負擔。
她強調，成長確實有幫助，卻無法夠快地完成必要調整，因此仍須搭配財政措施。
IMF同日發布的《財政監測報告》也警告，在借貸成本升高的環境下，延後處理債務，只會讓未來整頓更加困難。IMF財政事務部主任Rodrigo Valdes指出，通膨、高債務與殖利率攀升，已壓縮政府的財政操作空間，因此IMF此次提高了呼籲採取行動的急迫程度。
儘管美國今年擔任二十國集團(G20)主席國，貝森特仍未出席曼谷年會，而是在期中選舉升溫之際優先安排國內活動。他近期積極宣傳川普經濟政策，尤其是共和黨去年通過的大幅減稅措施。G20財長預定周四在年會場邊集會。

中國應擴大內需 歐洲須強化投資與競爭力

美國利用G20主席國地位，呼籲盟友加強因應中國「非市場」經濟政策，認為這些政策造成產能過剩及大量產品湧入全球市場。
在最新數據顯示中國貿易順差可望再創紀錄之際，喬治艾娃重申，順差國應增加國內消費，中國尤其需要將成長模式由出口轉向內需；逆差國則須增加儲蓄、減少支出，歐洲應加強投資以提升競爭力。
歐洲債務問題也成為年會焦點。法國是全球債券拋售潮中受創較重的先進經濟體之一，歐洲央行總裁拉加德(Christine Lagarde)表示，法國必須透過財政整頓處理自身債務問題，淡化市場對央行介入債市的猜測。
拉加德在曼谷一場《CNN》活動上指出，安撫投資人的首要解方在法國國內，關鍵是財政政策。
對英國，IMF則肯定其整頓進展，但不希望加快緊縮步調。Valdes表示，建議是「維持既定路線」。
經濟合作暨發展組織(OECD)秘書長Mathias Cormann也呼籲維持嚴格財政紀律。他指出，除德國與土耳其外，所有G20國家今年第一季的公債占國內生產毛額(GDP)比率，均高於2007年底。
他主張，各國應控制並重新分配支出、提升公部門效率及稅制效能，同時保護教育、技能與數位基礎建設等有助未來成長的投資。

高殖利率衝擊窮國 償債支出占收入比重倍增

本周年會也關注AI投資熱潮可能擴大各國差距。部分先進經濟體受惠於AI資金湧入，另一些國家卻未能分享成長機會。
喬治艾娃呼籲會員國充分挹注支援低所得與脆弱國家的IMF基金，包括提供低利及無息貸款的「減貧與成長信託」，以及透過贈款協助最貧窮、最脆弱會員國減輕或免除償債負擔的「災難控制與救濟信託」。
她指出，即使這些國家的整體債務負擔已減輕，仍受到殖利率攀升擠壓，平均償債成本占政府收入比重，已由十年前的6%升至14%。
喬治艾娃警告，對原本就落後的國家而言，全球經濟發展差距擴大的風險尤其危險。
paras_en: Global bond yields are rising and government debt pressures are intensifying. IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva urged major economies on Wednesday (the 14th) to adjust policies, stating that the United States cannot rely solely on economic growth to solve its debt problem and must still take tax or spending measures; China should reduce its reliance on exports and shift toward expanding domestic consumption.

According to Reuters, Georgieva said at the IMF‑World Bank Annual Meetings in Bangkok that the United States and other advanced economies in Europe have the most severe debt‑overhang problems. Their benchmark sovereign‑bond yields are climbing, which also transmits pressure to low‑income countries that have already been forced by financial markets to cut borrowing.
She summed up the policy direction for the major economies as: “China needs to consume more, the United States must save more, and Europe must invest more.”

The United States cannot rely on growth alone to reduce debt – IMF raises urgency of fiscal consolidation. When asked whether the United States needs to tighten fiscal policy, Georgieva said Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen recognizes that deficits and debt levels are too high and need to become more sustainable, but the U.S. government is currently heavily dependent on strong economic growth to ease the burden.
She stressed that growth does help, but it cannot adjust fast enough, so fiscal measures are still required.

The IMF’s Fiscal Monitor released the same day also warned that in an environment of rising borrowing costs, postponing debt‑reduction will only make future adjustment more difficult. IMF Fiscal Affairs Director Rodrigo Valdes said that inflation, high debt and climbing yields have squeezed governments’ fiscal space, prompting the IMF to raise the urgency of taking action this time.

Although the United States is this year’s G20 chair, Yellen has not attended the Bangkok meetings, opting instead to focus on domestic activities as the mid‑term elections heat up. She has recently been promoting Trump‑era economic policies, especially the large tax cuts passed by the Republican‑controlled Congress last year. G20 finance ministers are slated to meet on Thursday on the sidelines of the summit.

China should expand domestic demand; Europe must strengthen investment and competitiveness. The United States is using its G20 chairmanship to urge allies to respond to China’s “non‑market” economic policies, which it says create overcapacity and flood the global market with products.

With the latest data showing China’s trade surplus likely to set a new record, Georgieva reiterated that surplus countries should boost domestic consumption. China especially needs to shift its growth model from export‑driven to demand‑driven; deficit countries should increase savings and cut spending, and Europe should step up investment to raise competitiveness.

Europe’s debt issue also featured prominently at the summit. France is one of the advanced economies hit hardest by the global bond‑sell‑off, and European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde said France must address its debt through fiscal consolidation, easing market speculation about central‑bank intervention in bond markets.
Lagarde told a CNN event in Bangkok that the primary way to reassure investors lies within France itself, and the key is fiscal policy.
Regarding the United Kingdom, the IMF praised its consolidation progress but said it does not want to accelerate tightening. Valdes said the recommendation is to “stay the course.”

OECD Secretary‑General Mathias Cormann also called for strict fiscal discipline. He noted that, aside from Germany and Turkey, all G20 countries had a public‑debt‑to‑GDP ratio in the first quarter of this year that was higher than at the end of 2007.

He argued that countries should control and reallocate spending, improve public‑sector efficiency and tax‑system effectiveness, while protecting investments in education, skills and digital infrastructure that support future growth.

High yields are hitting poor nations, doubling the share of revenue spent on debt service. The summit also focused on how the AI investment boom could widen gaps between countries. Some advanced economies benefit from an influx of AI capital, while others fail to share in the growth opportunities.

Georgieva called on member states to fully fund IMF resources for low‑income and vulnerable countries, including the “Poverty‑Reduction and Growth Trust,” which offers low‑interest and interest‑free loans, and the “Catastrophe Containment and Relief Trust,” which provides grants to help the poorest and most vulnerable members reduce or eliminate debt‑service burdens.

She noted that even though the overall debt burden of these countries has eased, they are still squeezed by rising yields, with the average debt‑service cost as a share of government revenue climbing from 6 % a decade ago to 14 %.
Georgieva warned that for already lagging nations, the risk of a widening global development gap is especially dangerous.

items.title: 最後一家也轉鷹！花旗改估Fed年底升息1碼 明年6月才降息
items.title_en: The Last Firm Also Turns Hawkish! Citi Revises Forecast to a 1‑Point Fed Rate Hike by Year‑End, No Cuts Until June Next Year
paras: 美國9月通膨高於預期，讓原本預估聯準會(Fed)今年不再調整利率的花旗集團(C-US)改變立場。花旗周三(14日)表示，現在預期Fed將於12月升息1碼，並在此後維持利率不變，直到2027年6月才開始降息。
據《路透》報導，在金融市場普遍預期Fed將於12月升息之際，花旗原本是唯一仍堅持今年利率不再變動的券商。此次通膨數據明顯高於預期，促使花旗轉向較鷹派的利率展望，加入預期年底前再升息的行列。
9月消費者物價漲勢因汽油成本飆升而加快，價格壓力也擴散至能源以外領域，引發市場對核心通膨可能持續居高不下的擔憂。
花旗指出，市場目前反映12月升息的機率約為94%。該行預期，Fed完成這次升息後將按兵不動，暫不進一步調整政策利率。
除了12月，市場也重新評估Fed提前於10月出手的可能性。根據芝商所(CME-US)FedWatch工具，與Fed政策利率連動的期貨顯示，10月27日至28日會議升息的機率已升至47.1%，高於通膨數據公布前的約22%。
paras_en: U.S. September inflation came in higher than expected, prompting Citi Group (C-US), which had previously projected that the Federal Reserve would not adjust rates this year, to change its stance. On Wednesday (the 14th), Citi said it now expects the Fed to raise rates by one basis point in December and then keep rates unchanged until a cut is initiated in June 2027.

According to Reuters, while markets broadly anticipated a December rate hike, Citi had been the only broker still insisting that rates would remain unchanged this year. The surprisingly strong inflation data pushed Citi toward a more hawkish outlook, joining the ranks of those expecting another hike before year‑end.
September’s consumer price increase accelerated due to a surge in gasoline costs, and price pressures spread beyond energy, raising market concerns that core inflation could remain persistently high.

Citi noted that the market currently assigns about a 94% probability to a December rate hike. The bank expects the Fed, after this hike, to stand pat and not make further policy rate adjustments for the time being.

In addition to December, the market has also reassessed the likelihood of an earlier Fed move in October. Using CME Group’s (CME-US) FedWatch tool, futures tied to the Fed’s policy rate show the probability of a hike at the Oct. 27‑28 meeting has risen to 47.1%, up from roughly 22% before the inflation data were released.

items.title_en: 'The Big Short' Michael Burry Predicts Market Top Within 9 Months, Shifts AI Short Strategy to Nasdaq 100 and Semiconductor ETF
paras: 《大賣空》原型、以預測2008年美國房市崩盤聞名的投資人貝瑞（Michael Burry），持續看空人工智慧（AI）熱潮帶動的股市漲勢，並表示自己已經進一步調整做空策略。
根據《Business Insider》報導，貝瑞近日在Substack發文，以「鞏固大賣空」（Consolidating the Big Short）為題詳細闡述了自己看空押注近期的變化。今年稍早，他曾揭露對輝達(NVDA-US) 與Palantir(PLTR-US) 等股價表現強勢的個股建立空頭部位，並隨後將放空部位轉為選擇權部位。
不過，貝瑞表示，自己現已將大部分選擇權部位轉為兩項指數型放空部位，包括買進NASDAQ100(NDX) 的看跌選擇權，以及VanEck Vectors 半導體 ETF(SMH-US) 的看跌選擇權。
對於後市，貝瑞表示，他預期未來9個月內，市場某個時點將出現一個「重大頂部」。他也認為，多頭行情的最後階段可能會相當「瘋狂」，在他預期的回檔到來之前，股價可能先快速飆升。
貝瑞寫道，VanEck半導體ETF「集中押注於市場上最熱門、股價漲幅也最為過度的半導體股票」。
他指出：「輝達占該基金19.6%，台積電ADR(TSM-US) 占9.3%，超微半導體(AMD-US) 占5.6%。博通(AVGO-US) 、美光科技(MU-US) 、邁威爾科技(MRVL-US) 及應用材料(AMAT-US) 的持股比重則都接近5%。」
貝瑞表示：「這些公司正是我非常熟悉、而且有意放空的個股。」
他也表示，自己買進的看跌選擇權將於2027年6月到期，這代表其看空論點大約還有8個月的時間接受市場驗證。
除了指數型部位，貝瑞仍直接押注部分個股下跌。他表示，目前仍持有熱門AI概念股甲骨文(ORCL-US) 與Palantir的看跌選擇權，另外也持有大都會人壽(MET-US) 及卡特彼勒(CAT-US) 的看跌選擇權。
貝瑞表示：「Palantir股價持續上漲，但成交量卻不斷萎縮，這顯示該股的漲勢可能正逐漸耗盡動能。」
paras_en: Michael Burry, the investor whose story inspired "The Big Short" and who famously predicted the 2008 US housing collapse, continues to bet against the AI‑driven rally in equities and says he has further adjusted his short strategy.

According to Business Insider, Burry recently posted on Substack under the headline "Consolidating the Big Short," detailing how his short bets have changed. Earlier this year he disclosed short positions on strong‑performing stocks such as Nvidia (NVDA-US) and Palantir (PLTR-US), later converting those shorts into options positions.
Burry now says he has turned most of those option positions into two index‑based short bets: put options on the Nasdaq‑100 (NDX) and put options on the VanEck Vectors Semiconductor ETF (SMH-US).

Looking ahead, Burry expects a "major top" to appear at some point within the next nine months. He also believes the final phase of the bull market could be quite "crazy," with prices potentially spiking higher before the anticipated pullback arrives.
Burry writes that the VanEck semiconductor ETF "concentrates bets on the market’s hottest and most over‑inflated semiconductor stocks."

He notes: "Nvidia makes up 19.6% of the fund, TSMC ADR (TSM-US) 9.3%, AMD (AMD-US) 5.6%. Broadcom (AVGO-US), Micron (MU-US), Marvell Technology (MRVL-US) and Applied Materials (AMAT-US) each sit near a 5% weighting."
Burry says: "These are the companies I know very well and intend to short."
He also says the puts he bought expire in June 2027, giving his bearish thesis roughly eight more months to be tested by the market.

In addition to the index positions, Burry still directly bets on individual stocks falling. He remains long put options on hot AI names Oracle (ORCL-US) and Palantir, and also holds puts on MetLife (MET-US) and Caterpillar (CAT-US).
Burry comments: "Palantir’s price keeps climbing, but its trading volume is steadily shrinking, indicating the rally may be losing momentum."

items.title: 法盛投資管理：AI熱潮席捲亞洲 投資人期待高報酬卻面臨風險落差
items.title_en: Faseng Investment Management: AI Wave Sweeps Asia, Investors Seek High Returns but Face Risk Gaps
paras: 過去18個月來，全球 AI 浪潮帶動亞洲股市大幅上揚，投資人對未來的長期回報預期亦隨之水漲船高。然而，法盛投資管理發布《2026 年亞洲投資人脈動調查》，發現亞洲投資人的預期報酬率與其風險承受能力之間存在顯著落差。面對 Fed 政策走勢與市場波動，專家建議善用美國股市的多樣性與非投資級債等配置，落實資產分散以確保長期穩健收益。
根據法盛投資管理於2026年8月針對香港、日本、新加坡、南韓及台灣共750名可投資資產達10萬美元以上投資人的調查，亞洲投資人預期的長期實質回報率(扣除通膨後)高達17.3%。其中以新加坡(20%)與南韓(19.6%)最高，南韓投資人的回報預期甚至是理財顧問合理推估(9.3%)的兩倍以上。
然而，調查中有 73% 的受訪者自認屬於保守型或穩健型投資人，顯現出市場出現顯著的「近因偏誤」，投資人因近期股市大漲而盲目調高預期，卻忽視了潛在的市場波動與風險承受極限。
法盛投資人洞察中心執行董事 Dave Goodsell 表示，亞洲投資人受到錯失恐懼(FOMO)驅使，對收益追求極為積極。例如南韓與台灣市場深受AI供應鏈及半導體題材帶動，投資人期望極高，但同時也面臨顯著的波動度與「機會風險」。相比之下，新加坡投資人的高預期則更多來自金融銀行業對AI產業融資及放款所帶來的效益。
針對美國聯準會 (Fed) 政策展望，法盛分析指出，Fed 官員(如Christopher Waller)近期言論偏向支持維持甚至調升利率以控制通膨與市場需求，目前預測利率將維持在4.25%左右，政策主軸在於引導經濟穩健發展而非阻礙成長。
在固定收益市場方面，法盛表示，近期市場波動加劇，投資級債券利差持續收窄，吸引力有所降低。相反地，對非投資等級債抱持較為積極的態度，主因其提供的利差回報能合理補償投資人承擔的風險，且在高利息收益的緩衝下，能有效降低市場修正帶來的衝擊。
針對台韓兩地在AI供應鏈中的地位，法盛分析，台灣在半導體與先進製造領域高居全球領導地位，對美國及全球市場而言均為不可或缺的關鍵夥伴。然而，台灣市場的產業集中度較高，相較之下，美股市場雖然同樣受到科技股驅動，但其整體經濟更具多樣性，涵蓋公用事業、能源、金融服務及工業製造(如波音)等多種板塊。
法盛提醒，隨著AI資本支出與市場競爭加劇，未來幾年市場將逐步回歸常態化，唯有具備強大現金流與獲利能力的龍頭企業能夠持續生存，而弱勢企業恐面臨融資困難。因此，投資人在追逐AI高報酬的同時，應特別注意避免過度集中於單一科技製造業，利用美股等多元化市場或非投資級債券分散風險。此外，台幣與美元高度相關，投資人應將匯率波動與技術創新週期納入考量。
調查也顯示，93%的台灣投資人比以往更重視跨區域分散，台灣投資人持有被動式ETF(61%)與主動式ETF(59%)的比例居亞洲之冠，顯示出台灣投資人在運用多元工具進行靈活配置上已日益成熟。
paras_en: Over the past 18 months, the global AI wave has driven Asian stock markets sharply higher, raising investors' expectations for long‑term returns. However, Faseng Investment Management’s "2026 Asian Investor Sentiment Survey" finds a significant gap between Asian investors’ expected returns and their risk tolerance. In light of Fed policy trends and market volatility, experts advise leveraging the diversity of U.S. equities and non‑investment‑grade bonds to achieve asset diversification and ensure steady long‑term gains.

Based on a survey conducted by Faseng Investment Management in August 2026 of 750 investors in Hong Kong, Japan, Singapore, South Korea and Taiwan who each have investable assets of at least $100,000, Asian investors expect a long‑term real (inflation‑adjusted) return of 17.3%. Singapore tops the list at 20% and South Korea follows at 19.6%, with South Korean investors’ expectations more than double the reasonable estimate of 9.3% offered by financial advisers.

Yet 73% of respondents describe themselves as conservative or moderate investors, revealing a pronounced "recency bias" in the market: investors have blindly raised expectations after recent stock market rallies while overlooking potential volatility and their own risk limits.

Dave Goodsell, Executive Director of Faseng’s Investor Insights Center, says Asian investors are driven by FOMO and pursue returns aggressively. For example, South Korean and Taiwanese markets are heavily influenced by AI supply‑chain and semiconductor themes, prompting very high expectations but also exposing investors to significant volatility and "opportunity risk". By contrast, Singapore investors’ lofty expectations stem more from the benefits of AI‑related financing and lending in the financial‑banking sector.

Regarding the Federal Reserve outlook, Faseng analysts note that Fed officials such as Christopher Waller have recently signaled support for maintaining or even raising rates to curb inflation and demand, with rates expected to stay around 4.25%. The policy focus is on guiding stable economic growth rather than stifling it.

In the fixed‑income arena, Faseng observes that recent market turbulence has narrowed investment‑grade bond spreads, reducing their appeal. Conversely, they take a more positive stance on non‑investment‑grade debt, citing its spread premium as a reasonable compensation for risk and its high‑interest buffer that can mitigate the impact of market corrections.

Analyzing the AI supply‑chain roles of Taiwan and South Korea, Faseng points out that Taiwan leads globally in semiconductors and advanced manufacturing, making it an indispensable partner for the U.S. and worldwide. However, Taiwan’s market is highly concentrated, whereas the U.S. market, though also tech‑driven, is more diversified across utilities, energy, financial services, industrial manufacturing (e.g., Boeing) and other sectors.

Faseng cautions that as AI capital spending and competition intensify, markets will gradually normalize over the next few years. Only companies with strong cash flow and profitability will survive, while weaker firms may face financing difficulties. Investors chasing AI’s high returns should avoid over‑concentration in a single tech manufacturing segment and use diversified markets like U.S. equities or non‑investment‑grade bonds to spread risk. Additionally, given the high correlation between the Taiwanese dollar and the U.S. dollar, currency fluctuations and technology‑innovation cycles should be factored into decisions.

The survey also shows that 93% of Taiwanese investors now place greater emphasis on cross‑regional diversification. Taiwanese investors hold passive ETFs (61%) and active ETFs (59%) at the highest rates in Asia, indicating a growing sophistication in using diverse tools for flexible portfolio allocation.

items.title: 〈智慧能源週〉聯華林德最快2028引進氫能車 「富氧燃燒」助台廠減碳、降廢氣排放
items.title_en: Smart Energy Week: Linde Lihua to Introduce Hydrogen Vehicles by 2028, Oxygen-Enriched Combustion Helps Taiwanese Plants Cut Carbon and Emissions
paras: 工業氣體廠聯華林德今(2026)年參與台灣國際智慧能源周展，大宗氣體暨清淨能源副總沈欣儒今(14)日表示，隨著工業減碳應用實績持續擴大，富氧燃燒技術已獲多家指標業者導入，藉由降低廢氣量、提升燃燒效率，產能可增加逾 50%，燃料耗用最高可降低 50%。
沈欣儒表示，目前聯華林德為串聯物流、運輸與氫能產業，推動「氫能即服務(HaaS)」模式，加速應用產業落地，目前在氫能運輸領域克服法規與成本門檻，應用在氫能大客車上，預計在 2028 年引進首批歐洲氫能重型車輛，朝在地化組裝發展。
另隨綠色新能源、低碳運輸工具正夯，連政府也宣布在2030年希望達到全電動車行駛，目前包括新能源車持續蓬勃湧現，全球氫能運輸逐漸以重型卡車、巴士及物流車等商用車為主要發展。
沈欣儒表示，公司繼去(2025)年與中油合作，共同完成加氫站建置後，聯華林德攜手聯華新能源及亞氫動力，進一步串聯物流車隊與運輸業者，導入符合歐規的氫能卡車，目標透過整合採購與服務模式，以降低客戶初期資本支出，加速氫能運輸導入時程。
沈欣儒坦言，聯華林德深耕氫能車多年，但目前台灣因為車用及道路法規嚴格限制下，台灣現階段僅對「氫能巴士」的大客車給予專案補貼，缺乏對其他重型車輛運輸的補助辦法，這也讓業者成為未來急需努力突破產業限制。
其次是氫汽車供應鏈的限制，沈欣儒表示，目前全球最大的氫能車輛生產基地在中國，但台灣受限於法規無法進口中國車輛，也增加導入組裝或生產的難度。
沈欣儒表示，目前聯華林德已引進約5輛「氫能巴士」大客車，目標是引進10輛左右數量，正進行政府的行駛及道路交通認證中，也與歐洲的貨車與卡車大廠洽談，預計最晚 2028 年引進首批車輛進口後，在進行驗證後可行駛於台灣。
至於初期引進的氫能巴士在價格部分，目前僅能原裝整輛氫能車經海關進口台灣，沈欣儒透露一輛車價格進口約台幣3千萬元左右，未來希望經過認證後，能夠逐步採取「在地化組裝」策略，期望藉此大幅降低建置成本，並配合政府未來可能的補貼，以利於各式各樣的氫能車在台灣落地銷售。
此外，隨台灣正式邁入碳定價新階段，聯華林德此次也展出富氧燃燒技術，可協助高碳排產業改善燃燒製程、提升能源效率，為工業減碳的重要技術選項，目前包括台泥(1101-TW)、華新(1605-TW)麗華、金聯成、羅東鋼鐵等業者已陸續導入相關技術，納入整體節能減碳策略中
日本知名煉鋼大廠千代田鋼鐵導入無焰純氧解決方案 OXYGON ，實測效益顯示： 燃氣消耗減少58.2%，盛鋼桶預熱時間從 5小時40分鐘縮短至 3小時。富氧/純氧燃燒所具備的低碳燃料轉換、製程改善及效能提升等特性，亦符合企業自主減量的減碳策略方向，聯華林德可依客戶需求打造解決方案，透過降低廢氣量及提升燃燒效率，產能最高可提升50% 以上。
paras_en: Linde Lihua, a industrial gases company, participated in Taiwan International Smart Energy Week this year. Deputy General Manager of Bulk Gases and Clean Energy, Shen Xinru, said that as industrial carbon‑reduction applications continue to expand, oxygen‑enriched combustion technology has already been adopted by several leading firms. By lowering exhaust volume and improving combustion efficiency, capacity can increase by more than 50% and fuel consumption can be cut by up to 50%.

Shen explained that Linde Lihua is linking logistics, transportation and the hydrogen sector to promote a “Hydrogen‑as‑a‑Service (HaaS)” model, accelerating market rollout. In the hydrogen‑transport arena, the company has overcome regulatory and cost barriers and is applying the technology to large hydrogen buses, with plans to bring the first batch of European heavy‑duty hydrogen vehicles to Taiwan in 2028 and develop local assembly.

With green new energy and low‑carbon transport gaining momentum, the government has announced a goal of achieving an all‑electric vehicle fleet by 2030. New‑energy vehicles continue to surge worldwide, and hydrogen transport is increasingly focused on heavy trucks, buses and logistics vehicles as the main commercial‑vehicle segment.

Shen noted that after completing a joint hydrogen‑refueling station with CPC Corp. in 2025, Linde Lihua partnered with Lihua New Energy and Asia Hydrogen Power to further connect logistics fleets and carriers, introducing European‑spec hydrogen trucks. The aim is to lower customers’ upfront capital costs through integrated procurement and service models, speeding up hydrogen‑fuel transport adoption.

Shen admitted that although Linde Lihua has been cultivating hydrogen vehicles for years, Taiwan’s strict vehicle and road regulations currently only provide project subsidies for large hydrogen buses. There is no support for other heavy‑vehicle transport, creating a pressing industry hurdle that must be overcome.

A second challenge is the hydrogen‑vehicle supply chain. Shen said the world’s largest hydrogen‑vehicle production base is in China, but Taiwanese regulations prohibit importing Chinese vehicles, adding difficulty to local assembly or manufacturing efforts.

Shen said Linde Lihua has already imported about five hydrogen buses, targeting roughly ten units. The fleet is undergoing government driving and road‑traffic certification, and talks are underway with major European truck manufacturers. The first batch is expected to arrive by 2028, after which verification will allow operation in Taiwan.

Regarding price, the initial hydrogen buses can only be imported as complete units. Shen disclosed that each vehicle costs about NT$30 million to import. The company hopes that, after certification, a “local‑assembly” strategy will dramatically lower costs and, together with possible future subsidies, enable a variety of hydrogen vehicles to be sold in Taiwan.

In addition, as Taiwan moves into a new phase of carbon pricing, Linde Lihua showcased its oxygen‑enriched combustion technology, which can help high‑carbon industries improve combustion processes and boost energy efficiency—an important option for industrial decarbonisation. Companies such as Taiwan Cement (1101‑TW), Hwa‑Shin (1605‑TW), Lihua, Jin‑Lian‑Cheng and Luodong Steel have begun adopting the technology as part of broader energy‑saving and carbon‑reduction strategies.

Japanese steel giant Chiyoda Steel has adopted the flame‑free pure‑oxygen solution OXYGON, achieving a 58.2% reduction in gas consumption and cutting pre‑heat time for steel ladles from 5 hours 40 minutes to 3 hours. The low‑carbon fuel conversion, process improvement and efficiency gains of oxygen‑enriched/pure‑oxygen combustion align with corporate emission‑reduction goals, and Linde Lihua can tailor solutions to customer needs, reducing exhaust and raising capacity by more than 50%.

items.title: 公股4金2銀前3季豪賺1345億成長逾2成 兆豐金奪雙冠王 華南金逼近去年全年
items.title_en: State-Owned Financial Holdings Post Strong Q3 Earnings of NT$134.5 Billion, Over 20% Growth; Mega Financial Tops Both Profit and EPS Rankings, Hua Nan Financial Near Last Year's Full-Year Level
paras: 公股四金二銀9月自結盈餘全數出爐，累計前三季合賺1345.13億元，年增22.21%，續創歷史同期新高。受惠台股交投熱絡與核心業務穩健發展，公股金融機構今年營運動能強勁，其中兆豐金 (2886-TW) 穩居獲利與每股稅後純益雙冠王，華南金 (2880-TW) 則以年增逾32%的表現拿下成長幅度之冠。
公股四金二銀9月單月合計獲利131.84億元，月減15.46%，主要受配息旺季結束及部分金融商品評價收益減少影響；但累計前三季整體獲利仍衝破1345億元大關，較去年同期顯著成長逾兩成。整體來看，除了銀行本業核心利息與手續費收入維持穩健外，證券子公司受惠台股大行情，自營及承銷收益大爆發，成為推升集團獲利改寫歷史新高的關鍵引擎。
兆豐金 (2886-TW) 9月單月稅後純益36.29億元，為公股六家唯一呈現月增。主要受惠兆豐證券自營與承銷獲利較上月增加逾5億元帶動，儘管兆豐銀行9月增加呆帳及其他各項提存，抵銷部分證券獲利增幅，金控單月獲利仍維持微幅上升。累計前三季兆豐金稅後純益達328.48億元，創歷年同期新高。
其中兆豐證券獲利年增約173%表現最為亮眼，經紀手續費與自營承銷收益同步暴增，9月單月獲利亦刷新歷史紀錄；兆豐銀行前三季稅後純益248.18億元、年增約6%，同樣刷新同期紀錄。兆豐票券前三季獲利年增約33%，主要受債券部位利差提升、外幣債券利息費用減少及票券成交量增加帶動；兆豐產險前三季獲利8.6億元，年增約29%。
華南金 (2880-TW) 前三季獲利增幅最為驚人，累計稅後純益263.67億元，年增32.43%，每股稅後純益達1.88元，前三季累計獲利已大幅逼近去年全年水準。華南金指出，除了銀行本業穩健成長外，證券及產險等非銀行子公司貢獻明顯提升，非銀行獲利占比提升至23%，成為驅動整體金控獲利暴增的第二支柱。
第一金 (2892-TW) 前三季累計獲利262.25億元，年增20.86%，每股稅後純益為1.82元。雖然9月受到配息旺季結束與金融商品評價損失影響，但第一銀行核心業務依舊強韌，第一金證券在投資與承銷收益挹注下，前三季獲利順利突破20億元大關，惟第一金人壽9月表現由盈轉虧。
合庫金 (5880-TW) 9月合併稅後淨利為19.24億元，累計前三季合併稅後淨利達202.49億元，年增26.8%，每股稅後純益1.22元，續創歷年同期新高。旗下主要獲利來源包括合庫銀行、合庫證券及合庫人壽，累計稅後淨利均創下歷史同期新高。
其中合庫銀行前三季累計稅後淨利179.84億元、年增12.07%；合庫證券累計稅後淨利17.22億元，較去年同期大增15.42億元；合庫人壽累計稅後淨利12.95億元，年增5.73億元，加上合庫票券、合庫資產管理與合庫創投等子公司同步獲利成長，整體集團展現多元獲利動能。
在兩家公股銀行方面，彰銀 (2801-TW) 累計前9月稅前盈餘已突破200億元大關，前九月累計合併稅後盈餘173.7億元，年增22.76%，主要得益於核心業務利息及手續費淨收益表現良好，展現極為穩定的獲利韌性。
臺企銀 (2834-TW) 9月獲利因遠匯與換匯交易處分、評價收益及股利收入減少影響，月減22.41%；但累計前九月獲利仍較去年同期成長約17%，主因存放利差擴大帶動利息淨收益大幅增加，營運基本面依舊健全。
paras_en: State-owned financial holdings comprising four banks and two insurers released their September consolidated earnings, showing a cumulative profit of NT$134.513 billion for the first three quarters, up 22.21% year‑over‑year and setting a new historical high for the period. Benefiting from lively Taiwan‑stock trading and solid core business development, these institutions showed strong operating momentum this year, with Mega Financial (2886‑TW) retaining the top spots for both net profit and earnings per share, while Hua Nan Financial (2880‑TW) claimed the highest growth rate with a year‑over‑year increase of more than 32%.

The four banks and two insurers posted a combined September profit of NT$13.184 billion, down 15.46% month‑over‑month, mainly due to the end of the dividend‑distribution season and reduced valuation gains on some financial products; nevertheless, the cumulative profit for the first three quarters still surpassed the NT$134.5 billion mark, representing a growth of over 20% compared with the same period last year. Overall, besides stable core interest and fee income from banking operations, securities subsidiaries rode the surge in Taiwan‑stock market activity, with proprietary trading and underwriting revenues exploding and becoming the key engine that pushed group profits to historic highs.

Mega Financial (2886‑TW) recorded a September net profit after tax of NT$3.629 billion, the only one among the six state‑owned institutions to show a month‑over‑month increase. The boost came mainly from Mega Securities, whose proprietary trading and underwriting earnings rose by more than NT$0.5 billion from the prior month, offset partially by higher loan loss provisions and other reserves at Mega Bank. Still, the financial holding’s monthly profit edged higher. For the first three quarters, Mega Financial’s net profit after tax reached NT$32.848 billion, a record high for the same period in history.

Mega Securities posted an eye‑catching year‑over‑year profit increase of about 173%, with brokerage fees and proprietary‑underwriting revenues soaring together, and its September profit also set a new record. Mega Bank posted a three‑quarter net profit after tax of NT$24.818 billion, up roughly 6% year‑over‑year, also a record for the period. Mega’s securities‑trading unit saw a three‑quarter profit rise of about 33%, driven by wider bond‑margin spreads, lower foreign‑currency bond interest expenses and higher bond‑trading volumes. Mega’s property‑and‑casualty insurance arm earned NT$860 million for the three quarters, up about 29% year‑over‑year.

Hua Nan Financial (2880‑TW) posted the most striking profit growth for the first three quarters, with cumulative net profit after tax of NT$26.367 billion, up 32.43% year‑over‑year, and earnings per share of NT$1.88. The three‑quarter profit has already closed in on last year’s full‑year level. Hua Nan noted that, beyond steady growth in its banking core, contributions from non‑bank subsidiaries such as securities and property‑insurance rose markedly, lifting the share of non‑bank profit to 23% and becoming the second pillar driving the overall surge in holding‑company earnings.

First Financial (2892‑TW) accumulated a profit of NT$26.225 billion for the first three quarters, up 20.86% year‑over‑year, with earnings per share of NT$1.82. Although September was affected by the end of the dividend season and valuation losses on financial products, First Bank’s core business remained resilient. First Financial Securities, bolstered by investment and underwriting income, pushed three‑quarter profit past the NT$2 billion threshold, while First Life turned from profit to loss in September.

Hua Nan Bank (5880‑TW) reported a September consolidated net profit after tax of NT$1.924 billion, bringing the three‑quarter consolidated net profit to NT$20.249 billion, up 26.8% year‑over‑year, with earnings per share of NT$1.22, again a record high for the period. Its main profit sources—Hua Nan Bank, Hua Nan Securities and Hua Nan Life—each posted historic‑period net profits.

For the three quarters, Hua Nan Bank posted a consolidated net profit after tax of NT$17.984 billion, up 12.07% year‑over‑year; Hua Nan Securities recorded NT$1.722 billion, a jump of NT$1.542 billion from the prior year; and Hua Nan Life earned NT$1.295 billion, up NT$0.573 billion. Together with profit growth from Hua Nan’s bond‑trading, asset‑management and venture‑capital subsidiaries, the group demonstrated diversified profit momentum.

Among the two state‑owned banks, Chang Hwa Bank (2801‑TW) saw its cumulative pre‑tax earnings for the first nine months exceed NT$20 billion, and its combined net profit after tax reached NT$17.37 billion, up 22.76% year‑over‑year, driven mainly by strong net interest and fee income from core operations, showcasing very stable profitability resilience.

Taiwan Business Bank (2834‑TW) posted a September profit decline of 22.41% month‑over‑month due to reduced gains from foreign‑exchange trading, valuation income and dividend receipts, yet its cumulative profit for the first nine months still grew about 17% versus the prior year, primarily because widening deposit‑rate spreads boosted net interest income, keeping the bank’s operational fundamentals sound.

items.title: 輝達再度出資台廠：預付京元電美國測試產能和認購聯發科ECB有何不同？
items.title_en: Nvidia Invests Again in Taiwanese Firms: How Does Its Prepayment to ASE Technology’s US Test Capacity Differ from Its Subscription to MediaTek’s ECB?
paras: 輝達 (NVDA) 繼8月底認購聯發科 (2454-TW) 海外可轉換公司債後，10月13日再與京元電 (2449-TW) 簽訂客戶預付款協議，接連以資金支持台灣半導體供應鏈。
不過，兩案雖同樣獲輝達資金挹注，合作目的及成長想像並不相同；前者是策略投資，後者則是預付測試服務費、提前鎖定產能。

對聯發科：認購可轉債合作充滿想像
聯發科8月31日宣布發行總額39億美元的海外可轉換公司債（ECB），輝達認購其中35億美元，債券票面利率為零，持有人未來得依約轉換為聯發科股票。
這筆交易使輝達取得債權及潛在股權，而非立即成為股東；對聯發科而言，則是在可轉債架構下取得長期資金，支持研發與業務擴展。
更關鍵的是，雙方同步宣布擴大AI基礎建設、終端AI運算及車用平台合作。聯發科在既有NVLink Fusion合作基礎上，進一步深化ASIC與機櫃級AI系統整合，降低CSP導入客製化XPU的門檻，不必完全從零打造Scale-up互連、記憶體架構及機櫃整合系統，這讓聯發科有機會爭取更多設計與系統整合商機。

對京元電：預付貨款確保後段產能供給
京元電則由公司及旗下美國子公司AeternZ與輝達簽署客戶預付款協議，由輝達先付款，京元電在美建置並預留測試產能，後續提供服務再逐步抵減。這筆資金並非股權投資，也不是收款當下即可認列的營收，其作用在於支撐美國廠初期投資、減輕資金壓力及提高產能需求能見度。
值得注意的是，京元電在9月17日曾因應美國子公司與客戶簽訂產能建置及保留合約需求，核准提供最高3億美元的連帶保證，顯示客戶原先要求台灣母公司為美國新廠履約提供保障。
不過京元電10月13日同步宣布取消該背書保證，改為共同輝達簽訂預付款協議的方式。
此次調整不僅確認輝達為美國測試產能的重要合作客戶，也讓雙方資金支持與產能保留的商業模式更加明確，但對於市場沒有進一步的驚喜：
京元電與輝達的合作早已深入核心測試業務。京元電8月底法說會指出，2025年上半年由GPU客戶率先帶動擴產，下半年再加入ASIC需求，且客戶集中度持續提高。2025年財報更顯示，最大單一客戶營收貢獻達126.5億元、占比36%，較前一年的18%倍增。
（圖片來源：優分析產業數據中心）
雖然公司未揭露該客戶身分，但結合輝達官方已將京元電列入Vera Rubin供應鏈，以及法人對Rubin GPU、Vera CPU測試訂單的分析，市場高度推測輝達已躍居京元電第一大客戶，更有法人預估輝達已佔京元電營收50%以上。
除了雙方合作早已在市場預期內，該預付協議條款亦未公開，因此無法確認實際風險分攤及訂單保障程度。
京元電2026全年資本支出於4月上調至500億元；而美國投資額上限為14億美元，於7月正式核准，規劃2028年小量運轉。
不過，隨AI晶片封裝與功耗提高，法人預期測試時間、預燒及散熱需求將同步提升，京元電的高功耗測試能力可望轉化為更高的單顆晶片測試價值。輝達選擇以預付款預留產能，也凸顯後段測試在供應鏈中的關鍵地位。
因此，兩案利多的時間與性質有別。聯發科最具想像的是藉輝達生態系開拓新客戶、新產品，ASIC業務成長有望擴大；
相較之下，京元電原本就是輝達重要GPU測試夥伴，美國設廠與客戶產能保留規劃也早已揭露。此次預付款協議的突破，主要在於確認輝達願意提供資金支持，降低海外建廠的資金壓力並確保己方需求無虞，但沒有進一步的數字與份額可以觀察。
京元電尚未揭露預付款金額、最低採購量及美國廠獲利條件，14億美元也只是投資額上限，不等同輝達資金承諾。能否進一步推升獲利，仍須觀察新廠稼動率、測試單價與成本結構，在後續產能爬坡時對於整體營利的影響。

paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA) followed its late‑August subscription to MediaTek (2454‑TW) overseas convertible bonds with a customer pre‑payment agreement with ASE Technology (2449‑TW) on October 13, continuing to fund Taiwan’s semiconductor supply chain with cash.

However, although both deals receive Nvidia funding, their purposes and growth narratives differ; the former is a strategic investment, while the latter is a pre‑payment for test services and an advance reservation of capacity.

For MediaTek: the convertible bond subscription is full of imagination. MediaTek announced on August 31 the issuance of $3.9 billion of overseas convertible bonds (ECB), of which Nvidia subscribed $3.5 billion. The bonds carry a zero coupon rate and holders can later convert them into MediaTek shares under the agreed terms.

This transaction gives Nvidia a debt claim and potential equity, not immediate shareholder status; for MediaTek, it secures long‑term financing under the ECB structure to support R&D and business expansion.

More importantly, both sides simultaneously announced an expansion of AI infrastructure, edge AI computing and automotive platform cooperation. Building on the existing NVLink Fusion partnership, MediaTek will deepen ASIC and rack‑level AI system integration, lowering the CSP’s barrier to adopt custom XPU without having to build scale‑up interconnects, memory architecture and rack integration from scratch, giving MediaTek a chance to win more design and system‑integration opportunities.

For ASE Technology: the pre‑payment secures downstream capacity supply. ASE and its U.S. subsidiary AeternZ signed a customer pre‑payment agreement with Nvidia, whereby Nvidia pays up front and ASE reserves test capacity in the United States, recouping the amount gradually as services are delivered. This is not an equity investment nor revenue that can be recognized immediately; it is intended to support early U.S. plant investment, ease cash‑flow pressure and improve visibility of capacity demand.

It is worth noting that on September 17 ASE approved a joint guarantee of up to $300 million to meet a capacity‑building and reservation contract required by its U.S. subsidiary’s customer, indicating the customer originally asked the Taiwanese parent to back the new U.S. plant’s performance.
However, on October 13 ASE announced the cancellation of that guarantee, replacing it with the joint pre‑payment agreement with Nvidia.

The adjustment not only confirms Nvidia as a key customer for U.S. test capacity, but also clarifies the commercial model of cash support and capacity reservation, though it does not bring any further surprise to the market:

ASE’s cooperation with Nvidia has long been deep in core testing services. At its late‑August earnings briefing, ASE said that in the first half of 2025 GPU customers will drive capacity expansion, with ASIC demand added in the second half, and that customer concentration will continue to rise. The 2025 financials later showed the top single customer contributed NT$12.65 billion, or 36% of revenue, more than double the 18% share a year earlier.
(Image source: You Analysis Industry Data Center)

Although the company did not disclose the customer’s identity, Nvidia’s official listing of ASE in the Vera Rubin supply chain and analysts’ reviews of Rubin GPU and Vera CPU test orders lead the market to strongly infer that Nvidia has become ASE’s largest customer, with some analysts estimating Nvidia now accounts for over 50% of ASE’s revenue.
Beyond the market’s expectation of the partnership, the terms of the pre‑payment agreement have not been made public, so the actual risk‑sharing and order‑guarantee levels cannot be verified.
ASE raised its 2026 full‑year capital expenditure in April to NT$50 billion; the U.S. investment cap is $1.4 billion, approved in July and slated for modest operation in 2028.

Nevertheless, as AI chip packaging and power consumption rise, analysts expect testing time, burn‑in and cooling needs to increase in tandem, and ASE’s high‑power testing capability could translate into higher per‑chip test value. Nvidia’s choice to pre‑pay for reserved capacity also highlights the critical role of downstream testing in the supply chain.
Thus, the two deals differ in timing and nature. MediaTek’s story is most imaginative, leveraging Nvidia’s ecosystem to open new customers and products, with ASIC business growth expected to expand;

In contrast, ASE has already been a key Nvidia GPU testing partner, and its U.S. plant and capacity‑reservation plans have long been disclosed. The breakthrough of this pre‑payment agreement lies mainly in confirming Nvidia’s willingness to provide cash support, easing the financing burden of overseas plant construction and securing its own demand, though no further figures or share allocations are disclosed.

ASE has not revealed the pre‑payment amount, minimum purchase volume or profit terms for the U.S. plant; the $1.4 billion figure is merely the investment cap and does not equal Nvidia’s cash commitment. Whether it can boost profitability will depend on the new plant’s utilization, test pricing and cost structure, and its impact on overall earnings as capacity ramps up.
